zh: 工具与能力目录更新审查与分块加密传输：需求看板支持工具、插件/脚本及技能的更新申请流程，支持成员提交更新候选包并安全存储于 RequirementUpdateFiles，配合客户端分块加密传输；管理员可在看板中一键审核与下载更新附件，审核通过前限制流转至已完成。
能力卡片更多操作与工具菜单体验增强：首页插件与脚本卡片新增更多操作菜单，支持快捷发起更新申请；工具上下文菜单增加最大高度限制与纵向滚动支持，防止菜单项超出屏幕；独立窗口打开自定义工具时新增「在工具中台管理」快捷链接。
共享工具与能力隐藏恢复状态保留：租户成员恢复已隐藏的共享工具或插件时，完整保留此前配置的个人别名与本地修改快照，避免恢复时覆盖定制内容。
en: Catalog update review workflow & chunked encrypted transport: added review submissions for tools, plugins/scripts, and skills with secure RequirementUpdateFiles attachment storage and client chunked encryption; administrators can review and download packages directly from the requirements board before approval.

Capability card more-actions & tool menu enhancements: added more-options menus to plugin & script cards for quick update submissions; constrained tool context menus to viewport height with vertical scrolling; added a direct "Manage in the tool hub" link when custom tools are opened standalone.

Shared tool & capability hide/restore preservation: restoring hidden shared tools or capabilities now cleanly preserves user-configured aliases and local customization snapshots without accidental overwrites.
